dedupe_keys.name: miami dade county open evacuation centers live feature service

description: This Miami-Dade County layer shows the general-public evacuation centres currently open, generated at the county Emergency Operations Center from WebEOC. Fields include shelter name, address, city and ZIP code, shelter type and status, whether it serves the general population, whether it is pet friendly, capacity and current occupancy, a post-storm flag, and incident and entry identifiers. The county notes that it has several evacuation centres but they may not be open or may be full at a given time; the layer returned zero features when read on 26 September 2026, outside an active incident, and the hub states weekly updates on Fridays. Coverage: Miami-Dade County, Florida. Access: free feature service and downloads. Licence: county terms. Caveats: an operational feed that is empty between events, so past openings are not retained here. Simulation uses: live shelter capacity and occupancy inputs to hurricane evacuation and shelter assignment models, and testing digital twin feeds. Related records: the FEMA ESF-6 open shelters layer and the Florida critical community and emergency facilities.
